name: Darnassus
summary: Darnassus shelters the night elves high among Teldrassil’s branches. Tyrande Whisperwind and the druids guide the city, where an ancient people face life without immortality and seek ties with the Alliance.

sections.title: A Crown High in the Branches
sections.body: Darnassus spreads across Teldrassil’s upper canopy, off northern Kalimdor’s coast. Wooden buildings and winding paths circle a quiet central lake. Bridges join terraces for tradesmen, craftsmen, Sentinels, and druids, leaving the wilderness close to the city’s daily life.

sections.title: Refuge of a Mortal People
sections.body: Darnassus is young beside the civilization of the kaldorei. After the Third War and the sacrifice of Nordrassil at Mount Hyjal, the night elves faced aging and sickness. With Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage lost in the Emerald Dream, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and his followers planted Teldrassil in hope of renewing their lost vitality. The city grew among its boughs as refuge and monument to their survival, though malaise already stirs among the tree’s roots.

sections.title: A Divided Hearth
sections.body: Darnassus holds two centers of authority. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind guides the spiritual life and defense of her people from the Temple of the Moon, with the Sentinels at her command. Across the waterways, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the druids in Malfurion’s absence. Both leaders present a united face to their new Alliance partners, yet friction between the priestesses and the druidic circle lingers.

faq.q: How do you travel to Darnassus from the mainland?
faq.answer: Teldrassil lies off Kalimdor’s northwest coast, and travelers reach Rut'theran Village at the tree’s foot by boat or flight. A glowing magical portal at the village docks carries them up to Darnassus.

High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind rules Darnassus and the kaldorei from the Temple of the Moon. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the druids from the Cenarion Enclave while Malfurion Stormrage remains lost in the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Why was the city founded so recently?
faq.answer: Darnassus was founded shortly after the Third War. The night elves sacrificed their immortality to defeat Archimonde at Mount Hyjal, and Fandral Staghelm urged them to grow Teldrassil in hope of reclaiming their former state. They made Darnassus among the tree’s boughs as a new refuge.

Malfurion Stormrage is missing in the Emerald Dream, where his spirit is trapped. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm governs the druids of Teldrassil in his absence, while Tyrande Whisperwind seeks a way to awaken and recover her beloved mate.

faq.q: Where are the profession trainers and shops located?
faq.answer: Darnassus’s terraces house its trainers and shops. The Craftsmen's Terrace has gathering and tailoring trainers and an inn; the Tradesmen's Terrace holds trade stalls and the Auction House. Blacksmithing and martial trainers are on the Warrior's Terrace, and the bank sits on the central island of the Temple Gardens.

faq.q: Why did the night elves join the Alliance?
faq.answer: After the Third War, the night elves faced growing pressure from the Horde, especially orcish logging in Ashenvale. Darnassus opened diplomatic ties and joined the Grand Alliance to find allies against those incursions and other rising threats across Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a night elf, you have Darnassus as the heart and sanctuary of your people while you face the trials of mortal life.
The Cenarion Enclave is the center of druidic training in Teldrassil, under Archdruid Fandral Staghelm’s demanding and uncompromising eye.
The Temple of the Moon is the holy center of the Sisters of Elune, led by High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.
Darnassus is the Alliance’s westernmost stronghold, offering naval and strategic shelter on Kalimdor.
